description:
Rooney Auctioneers bring to the market no 32 Oakleigh Wood, Dooradoyle this is an exceptionally spacious three bed duplex set at the heart of Dooradoyle. This property is presented in turn-key condition, beautifully finished. Easily one of the best residential developments within the Dooradoyle/Raheen environs. The development is within walking distance of the ever-expanding Raheen Business Park, home to some of the largest multinational corporations in Ireland, including Analogue Devices, Regeneron, Stryker and Dell. University Hospital Limerick is also just short walk from the complex, meaning the locality is popular with nurses, doctors and medical staff who value commuting time and unrivalled residential amenities. The Crescent Shopping Centre is just stones throw from the property offering some of the best shopping in the mid-west, in addition to a wide selection of restaurants, cafes and food outlets. Internally, the property comprises large living room with patio door to the front, large fully fitted kitchen with dishwasher & fridge & fitted oved/hob.  upgraded gas boiler kitchen having access to patio area, hallway having under stairs utility room, upstairs three large double bedrooms with built in wardrobes (1 en-suite) with electric shower, main bathroom with bath having electric shower. This making it the perfect choice for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors.  Contact Peter Kearney.
